- [LLEX.7.5.5] **Indentation tracking** inside an unbalanced bracket group
  is suspended. The lexer still reads characters but doesn't
  emit `INDENT` / `DEDENT` until the group closes.
  Consequently, the 4-space multiple constraint (LLEX.6.4) is
  also suspended for those lines — any leading-space count is
  accepted. This matches Python's bracket-continuation
  semantics and is the standard mechanism for multi-line
  `where` predicates, written inside one parenthesised group.

  The continuation lines inside `(` / `)` may be indented to
  any column; the 4-space rule resumes after the closing `)`.
